content.text: SNIPER: secret-hound - Your Codebase's Silent Guardian

text: An advanced, hybrid C++/Go/Python tool that hunts down leaked secrets in your
codebase and Git history. It combines high-performance, multi-threaded scanning
with intelligent, rule-based detection and Shannon entropy analysis.
[cyan]<PATH>[/]                (Default Mode) File or directory to scan. Defaults to the
current directory if no other mode is specified.
[green]--scan-git[/]            [bold]Git Mode.[/] Scans the repository's entire Git history for secrets.
[dim]The <PATH> argument is ignored in this mode.[/dim]
[green]-r, --rules <FILE>[/]      Path to a custom JSON rules file to use instead of the default.
[green]--include <ID1,ID2>[/]    Only run specific rule IDs (e.g., 'AWS_KEY,GITHUB_TOKEN').
[green]-c, --confidence <lvl>[/]   Minimum confidence to report: [cyan]low, medium, high[/] (default: low).
[green]--no-hidden[/]             Exclude hidden files and directories (names starting with '.').
[dim]By default, hidden files ARE scanned.[/dim]
[green]--depth <N>[/]            [dim](Git Mode Only)[/] Limit history scan to the last N commits (default: 100).
[green]-o, --output <FILE>[/]   Save the full report to a file in JSON format.
[green]-h, --help[/]             Show this help message and exit.
• [bold]Git:[/bold] Required for [green]--scan-git[/] mode.
• [bold]Go Toolchain:[/bold] Required by the [cyan]git_analyzer[/] backend.
• [bold]C++ Compiler & Libs:[/bold] Required for the [cyan]hound-core[/] scanner.
[dim]These are installed automatically by the main 'sniper' installer.[/dim]
[bold yellow]Problem:[/] Command fails with 'binary not found'.
[bold green]Solution:[/]  Run the main project builder from the 'sniper' root directory:
[cyan]make install[/]
[bold yellow]Problem:[/] Scan is slow or finds no secrets in a known dirty repository.
[bold green]Solution:[/]  Ensure you are running the scan from the root of the Git repository
when using [cyan]--scan-git[/]. Also, try scanning with [cyan]--confidence low[/].
[#] Perform a quick, default scan on the current directory (including hidden files):
[yellow]secret-hound[/]
[#] Scan a specific project folder, ignoring hidden files:
[yellow]secret-hound[/] [cyan]~/my-project[/] [green]--no-hidden[/]
[#] Scan your entire Git history for only high-confidence secrets:
[yellow]secret-hound[/] [green]--scan-git --confidence high --depth 9999[/]
[#] Scan for just AWS keys and save the JSON output:
[yellow]secret-hound[/] [cyan].[/] [green]--include AWS_KEY,AWS_SECRET_KEY -o report.json[/]
